note: R17 spec §27. Fixture Z (detailed plan, phase network, 6% allowance) carrying a user_qs benchmark set of seven fictional rates — five area rows (one priced per ft² at source), one per-unit row, one lump sum and one percentage row — currentised by the index ratio 126/120 = 1.05 and a location factor of 95 (multiplier 0.95), with one row adjusted −10% for a stated reason, seven selections mapped one-to-one onto the plan's packages, and one application already performed: the kitchens row was applied as a draft `finishes` package carrying `benchmark_origin`, and the QS base date was aligned to the currentisation date (2026-06-01) as the apply seam requires (§27.3). Every rate is fictional: TEST FIXTURE — NOT MARKET DATA. The benchmark figures are hand-derived in test-cases.md §27 before either engine runs; the ledger-dependent figures (TDC, peak debt, profit) are identity-asserted against the same document with the benchmark block removed (the advisory proof), fixture AA's rule. The material-variance threshold is set to 10% (not the 15% default) so the red flag fires on a −13.7% variance and the threshold is shown to be configurable.
